definition.simple: A right to buy the underlying at the strike price. The buyer pays a premium for it.
definition.balanced: At expiry a call is worth price − strike per unit if the price is above the strike, and nothing otherwise. A call buyer can lose at most the premium paid. A call seller receives the premium and must sell at the strike if [[assignment|assigned]]; an [[uncovered-option|uncovered]] sold call has no fixed limit on loss.
